## 4. Major AI Data Center News

- **Date:** 2026-09-21  
  **Source:** [Microsoft — AI-ready capabilities across India cloud infrastructure](https://news.microsoft.com/source/asia/2026/09/21/ai-ambition-into-action-microsoft-brings-ai-ready-capabilities-across-its-india-cloud-infrastructure-establishes-india-south-central-region-as-a-strategic-hub-for-asia-and-global-south/)  
  **Summary:** Microsoft said its Hyderabad-based India South Central region is live with AI-capable cloud infrastructure, three-zone resilience, data-residency options, and low-water cooling. It frames the region as a strategic AI hub for Asia and the Global South.  
  **Why it matters:** Expands regional AI compute availability and data-residency options in a high-growth market; source is company self-reporting, so treat capacity claims as vendor-stated.
